system.description:
Bloodline Point Cost: 2

(You must have Latent Branch Family & Latent Byakugan I) Beginning at 3rd level, you have been taught how to fight with the Hyuga’s legendary Gentle fist stance. You can roll a d6, in place of your normal unarmed damage die. Additionally, your unarmed attacks deal Chakra damage. If targeting an undead or construct you treat them as if they have resistance to your unarmed attacks while in this stance.
